questions.question: A sum of Rs. 7,560 is divided between A, B and C such that if their shares are diminished by Rs. 400, Rs. 300 and Rs. 260, respectively, then their shares are in the ratio 4 ∶ 2 ∶ 5. What is the original share of B?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Sum of Rs. 7560 is divided among A,B and C

If Rs 400, 300 and 260 is taken from A,B and C respectively then their shares ratio is 4 ∶ 2 ∶ 5

**Calculation :**

Shares of A,B and C is diminished by Rs. 400, Rs. 300 and Rs. 260 respectively

Diminished sum = Rs.7560 - (400 + 300 +260)

⇒ Rs.6600

The new ratio is 4 ∶ 2 ∶ 5 = 11 units 

⇒ 11 units = Rs. 6600

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 600

⇒ Share of B after diminishing = 2 × 600

⇒ Rs. 1200

 B was diminished by Rs. 300

**∴ Original share of B is Rs. 1500**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 2,400. It is sold for Rs. 1,542.24 after allowing three successive discounts of 15%,10% and x%. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Value after first two discounts = 2400 × 0.85 × 0.90 = 1836

Remaining **multiplying factor** for the third discount = 1542.24 ÷ 1836 = 0.84

Third discount **percentage (x)** = (1 − 0.84) × 100 = 16%

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Marked Price** (MP) = ₹2,400, **Selling Price** (SP) = ₹1,542.24, **Successive Discounts** = 15%, 10%, and x%

**Formula Used:** SP = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100 × (100 − x)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d09a552c3db25dfecb1a303b9169d5e5cf063f930afb02a0a6195baff5c631a.png] 

⇒ Price after 15% discount = 2400 − (15/100 × 2400) = 2400 − 360 = ₹2,040

⇒ Price after 10% discount = 2040 − (10/100 × 2040) = 2040 − 204 = ₹1,836

⇒ Price after x% discount = 1836 × (100 − x)/100 = 1542.24

⇒ (100 − x)/100 = 1542.24 ÷ 1836

⇒ 100 − x = 0.84 × 100

⇒ 100 − x = 84

⇒ x = 100 − 84 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts Formula

For two successive discounts a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Net Selling Price

The final price after n discounts is given by SP = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × ... × (1 − dₙ/100).

Single Equivalent Discount for Multiple Rates

Total Discount % = 100 × [1 − (1 − d₁/100)(1 − d₂/100)(1 − d₃/100)].

questions.question: Two positive integers differ by 1627. When the largest integer is divided by the smaller, the quotient is 7 and the remainder is 157. The sum of the digits of the smaller integer is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The difference between the numbers is 1627.

Subtract the remainder from this difference: 1627 − 157 = 1470.

The **quotient** is 7, which means the difference represents (7 − 1) = 6 parts of the **smaller integer**.

Smaller integer = 1470 ÷ 6 = 245.

Sum of digits of 245 = 2 + 4 + 5 = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between two integers = 1627

Quotient (Q) = 7 and Remainder (R) = 157

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/565b30c8885f3f5039ed713a34c4caa833af7173b11a8d4d7ff89107dd4c87d3.png] 

Let the **smaller integer** be x and the **larger integer** be y.

⇒ y − x = 1627 ... (Equation 1)

⇒ y = (x × 7) + 157 ... (Equation 2)

Substitute the value of y from Equation 2 into Equation 1:

⇒ (7x + 157) − x = 1627

⇒ 6x + 157 = 1627

⇒ 6x = 1627 − 157

⇒ 6x = 1470

⇒ x = 1470 ÷ 6

⇒ x = 245

Calculation of sum of digits of 245:

⇒ Sum = 2 + 4 + 5 = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

**__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

For any two positive integers a and b, there exist unique integers q and r such that a = bq + r, where 0 ≤ r < b.

Sum of Digits Property

The sum of digits of a number is used in the **divisibility rule** for 3 and 9. If the sum is divisible by 3 or 9, the number is also divisible by 3 or 9 respectively.

Positive Integers

Positive integers are the set of natural numbers {1, 2, 3, ...}. In division, the divisor must always be greater than the remainder.</p

questions.question: The amount obtained by investing a certain sum at r% p. a. for 4 years simple interest is equal to the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 14 years. What is the value of r?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount obtained at a sum for 4 years at r % = SI on the same sum at r % for 14 years

**Formula used ;**

Amount = Principal + SI

SI = {Ptimes rtimes t over 100}

**Calculation :**

Let the principal be P

According to the question

The amount for 4 years at r % = SI for 14 years at r %

P + SI for 4 years at r % = SI for 14 years at r %

⇒ P + {Ptimes rtimes t over 100} = {Ptimes rtimes T over 100}

⇒ P + {Ptimes rtimes 4 over 100} = {Ptimes rtimes 14 over 100}

⇒ P = (14Pr/100) - (4Pr/100)

⇒ P = 10Pr/100

⇒ P = Pr/10

⇒ r = 10

**∴ The value of 'r' is 10 %**

questions.question: A person travelled a distance of 60 km and then returned to the starting point. The time taken by him for the return journey was (1)/(2) hour more than the time taken for the outward journey, and the speed during the return journey was 10 km/h less than that during the outward journey. His speed during the outward journey (in km/h) was:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The person traveled 60 km and returned to the same point

Time taken for return journey = 1/2 Hr + Time taken for outward journey

Speed during return journey = Speed during the outward journey - 10 km/h 

**Formula used :**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation :**

Let the Speed of outward journey be S₁ and speed for return journey be S₂

Also, Let the time taken for outward journey be T₁ and time taken for return journey be T₂

 According to question,

S₁ = 60/ T₁ 

⇒ T₁ = 60/S₁ ----(1)

Also, from given information in question

T₁ + 1/2 = T₂ ----(2)

S₂ = S₁ - 10 ----(3)

For return journey

T₂ = 60 / S₂

From Eq (2) and (3), we have

⇒ T₁ + 1/2 = 60 / (S₁ - 10)

⇒ (60/S₁) +1/2 = 60 / (S₁ - 10)

⇒ {600 over (S1-10)S1} = {1over2}

⇒ S₁ (S₁ - 10) = 1200

⇒ S₁ = 40

**∴ Speed of the person during outward journey is 40 km/h**

The ratio of boys and girls in class = 9 ∶ 7

 {Average weight}= {Total weight over Total no. of people}

questions.question: A can do 33(1)/(3)\% of a work in 10 days and B can do 66(2)/(3)\% of the same work in 8 days. Both together worked for 8 days then C alone completes the remaining work in 3 days. A and C together will complete (5)/(6) part of the original work in:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A can do 33{1over 3}% of work in 10 days

B can do 66{2 over 3}% of the work in 8 days

**Concept used :**

Work done = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation :**

A does 1/3 part of the work in 10 days

⇒ A can do whole work alone in (10 × 3)days

⇒ 30 days ----(1)

B does 2/3 part of the work in 8 days

⇒ B will do the whole work alone in (8 × 3)/2 days

⇒ 12 days ----(2)

Now from eq (1) and (2), we can have

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/792ffc1d413ba3b2151c1518731a41bc474b5e6dd51b231f16a7f744631d8a48.png] 

A and B worked for 8 days

⇒ worked done by A and B in 8 days = (2+5) × 8 Units

⇒ 56 units

Now, the rest of the work (60 - 56) i.e 4 units work is done by 'C' in 3 days

⇒ The efficiency of C = 4/3 units

The total efficiency of A and C = 2 + (4/3)

⇒ 10/3 units

A and C have to do 5/6 of the original work

⇒ (5/6) × 60 = 50 units work to be done by A and C

⇒ Time taken by A and C to do 50 units of work = {50 over 10/3}

⇒ 15 days

**∴ A and C will complete 5/6 of the original work in 15 days**.

questions.question: Arun spends 30% of his monthly income on groceries, 20% of the remaining on rent, and 45% of the remaining on children's education and others. If he saves Rs. 5,544 a month, then how much (in Rs.) does he spend on rent?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

30% spends on groceries

20% of the remaining spends on rent and

45% of the remaining spends on children's education

**Calculation :**

Let the total monthly income be Rs.100 units

⇒ Groceries = 30 (now, remaining Rs.70)

⇒ Rent = 20% of 70

⇒ Rent = 14 units (now,remaining Rs. 70 - 14 = 56)

⇒ Children's education = 45% of 56

⇒ Children's education = 25.2

⇒Total spending = 30 + 14 + 25.2 = 69.2

⇒ Total monthly savings = 100 - 69.2

⇒ 30.8

According to question,

30.8 units = Rs.5544

⇒ 1 unit = Rs.180

∵ Spending on rent is 14 units

**∴ Arun spends Rs.2520 on rent**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__****Let Arun's income be y**

⇒ y × 7/10 × 4/5 × 11/20 = 5544

⇒ y = (5544 × 10 × 5 × 20)/(7 × 4 × 11)

⇒ y = 18000

Amount spend on rent = 18000 × 7/10 × 1/5 = 2520

∴ Arun spends Rs.2520 on rent.
